tasks.description: DEC-20260808-6a7ac4 rejected H-XOR-d1a480's claim that the x-oracle improves yield over exhaustive search, on the ground that the experiment tested oracle-vs-random-predictor rather than oracle-vs-exhaustive-search. Design one or both of: (1) direct Arm A (exhaustive) vs Arm B (x-oracle MITM) comparison, or (2) an 'Arm D: Random-from-F_p MITM' true-null control for the MITM mechanism itself. Must include a charged cost model (field operations or wall-clock) before any 'speedup' language, per the red-team's still-open MODERATE objection.
